title: streaming-lifecycle-controls-client-cancel-disconnect-reconnect-server-timeouts-openai-compat
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Improve stability and correctness of streaming sessions across client-side cancels, network disconnects, and reconnect/resume flows. This PR centralizes lifecycle handling in the streaming runtime, adds server-side idle/response timeouts, and improves the OpenAI-compatibility layer so that client cancel semantics and reconnect/resume behave like public API expectations.

Summary of changes: consolidated lifecycle state machine (client_cancel, client_disconnect, resume_token), added resume token generation/validation, server-side idle and tail timeouts with configurable defaults, backpressure-safe reconnect handling that replays KV cache metadata when available, and compatibility shims for OpenAI-style streaming clients (graceful CANCEL, reconnection semantics). Also includes e2e tests and expanded docs.

Backwards compatibility: default settings preserve previous behavior for most customers. Resume tokens are opt-in via a new route header (X-Resume-Enabled) for hosted API to avoid accidental exposure for older SDKs. OpenAI compatibility mode is toggled by the existing compat query param and now covers cancel/reconnect semantics more closely.

Testing & QA: unit tests for state transitions, integration tests simulating network dropout/rapid reconnects, load tests with perf-canary harness to validate no regression in throughput. CI showed a flaky integration test that was fixed by increasing retry backoff in test harness.

Rollout plan: staged rollout behind a feature flag for hosted tier (2% -> 20% -> 100%), Dedicated customers can opt-in via config, Private deploys receive manifest changes in the private-installer repo. Observability: new metrics (stream.session_resume_attempts, stream.session_resumed, stream.session_timeouts) and tracing tags (stream.resume_token, stream.lifecycle_event).

Related work: Linear ENG-4821, ENG-4898. Linked support case SUP-1971 investigated production incidence where clients were receiving partial streams after disconnects.

Notes: kept changes minimally invasive to serving hot path; kernel selection / batching unchanged. See files_changed for precise surface changes.

review_comments: Miguel Torres (2025-11-13): Overall looks good. Can we make resume tokens TTL-configurable per-customer? Small comment on token encoding length.
Asha Patel (2025-11-14): Added TTL config (defaults to 5m) and switched to compact base62 encoding to reduce header size.
Linus Becker (2025-11-15): Found race in state transition when cancel arrives during resume; suggested using CAS on session state.
Asha Patel (2025-11-16): Fixed race by converting state transitions to atomic compare-and-swap and added unit tests to cover the window.
Priya Raman (2025-11-17): Integration tests look good; one test showed a 5% failure on high-concurrency reconnects  increased backoff and retried in harness.
Elliot Wong (2025-11-18): Approved after verifying metrics and tracing additions in staging.
Release Lead (2025-11-19): Please include rollout plan and opt-in details in release notes.
release_notes:
- Add streaming lifecycle state machine to improve handling of client cancel, disconnect, and reconnect/resume flows.
- Introduce server idle and tail timeouts (configurable).
- Resume tokens for reconnect/resume (opt-in via X-Resume-Enabled).
- OpenAI compatibility: align cancel/reconnect semantics with public clients.
- New metrics: stream.session_resume_attempts, stream.session_resumed, stream.session_timeouts.
notes: Staged rollout behind feature flag. Private and Dedicated deployments need configuration to enable resume tokens. Documented in docs/api/streaming_lifecycle.md.
